notes.title: Demo available!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p align="start"]I'm Abel, and I'm pleased to announce that after a lot of hard work, the demo for The State of Nowhere is now available! Feel free to share any issues or suggestions you have to improve the game. I’ll be making improvements and fixing any bugs that come up between now and the official release date. Also, remember to join the Discord channel.[/p][p align="start"]Have a great day! :)[/p]
